title: Software Engineer
excerpt: Ran product engineering for BizSphere, a sales enablement platform used by 50,000 IBM sellers. Architected its SPA and client-side state management years before those patterns were standard.
html:
Ran product engineering for BizSphere, a sales enablement platform used by 50,000 IBM sales professionals worldwide.

Architected the BizSphere single-page application and built a state management library for data loading and caching — roughly five years before comparable patterns became standard — plus a reusable UI and graphing component library that accelerated prototyping across teams.
